name: InfluxDB 3.0 Sink
shortDescription: Consume data from a Kafka topic in Quix and persist the data to an InfluxDB 3.0 database.

Variables.Name: influxdb3
Variables.Description: Shared InfluxDB v3 connection details and admin token (used by this server and by every client that reads/writes it)
Variables.VariableGroupDescription: Shared InfluxDB v3 connection details and admin token (used by this server and by every client that reads/writes it)

Variables.Description: Base URL clients use to reach InfluxDB v3 over the internal Quix network
Whether to enable InfluxDB v3 authentication. Set to 'true' to require INFLUXDB3_TOKEN; leave 'false' to run without auth.
InfluxDB v3 admin token. Only used when INFLUXDB3_USE_TOKEN is 'true', in which case it must start with 'apiv3_'. Seeds server auth on first boot and authenticates clients.
Default database clients read from and write to
Organization id. Required by some clients (e.g. Quix Streams) but not used by InfluxDB 3 Core.

Variables.Name: INFLUXDB_MEASUREMENT_NAME
Variables.Description: The InfluxDB measurement to write data to. If not specified, the name of the input topic will be used

Variables.Name: INFLUXDB_TAG_KEYS
Variables.Description: The tags to include when writing the measurement data. Example: Tag1,Tag2

Variables.Name: INFLUXDB_FIELD_KEYS
Variables.Description: The fields to include when writing the measurement data. Example: Field1,Field2

Variables.Name: CONSUMER_GROUP_NAME
Variables.Description: The name of the consumer group to use when consuming from Kafka

Variables.Name: TIMESTAMP_COLUMN
Variables.Description: The column containing the timestamp column. Interpreted using INFLUXDB_TIME_PRECISION (default nanoseconds)

Variables.Name: INFLUXDB_TIME_PRECISION
Variables.Description: Precision of the TIMESTAMP_COLUMN values written to InfluxDB. One of: ns, us, ms, s

Variables.Name: BUFFER_SIZE
Variables.Description: The number of records that sink holds before flush data to the InfluxDb

Variables.Name: BUFFER_TIMEOUT
Variables.Description: The number of seconds that sink holds before flush data to the InfluxDb
